source.title: Union admission soundness: a union slot accepts and stores values that satisfy no alternative

reverification.probe: A hard Variant holding a RefCounted passed to `take(v: int | String)` now fails the runtime membership test (`Argument 1 has type "Box", but the parameter requires "String | int"`).

rationale: The unproven_source_requires_membership exception derives runtime_obligation=union_membership_check for every unproven source into a union destination; the matrix observes the checked store on both surfaces.
